definition: Ali Farhadi is a professor of computer science and the CEO of the Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence (AI2).

story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. That is Ali Farhadi — a small key that opens a big door.
